div.span: (No separate service layer; controllers hold business logic)

MongoDB Database
mongodb://localhost:27017/imovies
Collections: users, movies, cinemas, screens, showtimes, bookings

Screen.js
Schema: cinemaId, rows, cols (Unused in routes)

Showtime.js
Schema: movie, cinema, embedded seats[]

Booking.js
Schema: ref, user, movie, showtime, seats[]

movieController.js
Regex search, genre filter, cascade showtime delete

wishlistController.js
Wishlist array push/filter on User

HTTP Request
(Method, URI, JSON Body, HTTP-only Cookie)
